target_statement: For every finite R>L5, a harmonic-renormalized actual-zeta cross block obeys a support-uniform-on-[L5,R] summable spectral-Carleson estimate independent of the localized ground floor.
trust_model: The proposed first result is a floating-point finite diagnostic; a theorem would require an analytic form-domain proof and later formal or interval certification.
first_unproved_edge: low-energy spectral-Carleson control for the harmonic-renormalized completed-zeta residual
mask_or_node_class: all actual zeta prime powers active at the enlarged support, together with the pole and complete archimedean remainder
source_data_retained: actual von Mangoldt prime-power coefficients, pole rank two, digamma archimedean term, support threshold convention, and old/new support nesting
coefficient_cone_and_sign: all complex functions in the localized logarithmic form domain; the finite diagnostic uses real parity-complete trial spaces
normalization: project support L=4a; first seed L5=2 log 5; angular Fourier transform; Wplus multiplier (1/2) log(1+4r^2)
height_window_and_one_sided_floor: not a QP/Turan height-band claim; target is strict positivity of every localized Weil form on each compact support range
quantifier_order: for every finite R, there exist explicit K_R and delta_R>0 such that for every L and admissible step delta in [L5,R], every dyadic old spectral band and every collar vector obey the stated operator inequality
resolution_required: continuum logarithmic form domain; finite Legendre/hat diagnostics must be refined simultaneously in old dimension, collar dimension, Fourier cutoff, and quadrature

rate_and_exponent_ledger.spectral_budget: band energy 2^k times a summable dimensionless sequence

feasibility_or_nonvacuity_witness: the rigorous positive endpoint lambda(2 log 5)>=5e-18 supplies the first old positive block
downstream_socket: compact-by-compact finite-step positivity -> cofinal all-support positivity -> global Weil positivity -> imported Weil criterion
why_not_target_renamed: the universal logarithmic interface is removed using a fixed positive reference form; the asserted estimate concerns the explicit bounded residual band by band and may be falsified without deciding the sign of the full Schur complement
abstract_convex_falsifier: Ae_m=2^-m e_m and B_delta 1=2^(-m/2)e_m at delta=e^-m shows compactness and norm convergence alone do not imply the estimate
fejer_falsifier: not applicable to this Weil-source operator claim
prime_density_pseudonode_falsifier: replace actual prime shifts by a matched smooth/discrete source only after the actual finite-source diagnostic; agreement would show that no arithmetic-specific line has yet been used
finite_actual_prime_diagnostic: at L5 and shrinking delta, compute the harmonic lift, verify exact cancellation for the reference form, and track normalized dyadic band budgets under simultaneous refinement
actual_prime_arithmetic_line: the low-band proof must retain the combined pole plus bounded digamma remainder minus all active actual-prime translations; componentwise absolute estimates are disallowed
decision_tree_change_if_proved: closes the zeta-specific adjacent-support edge on every compact range and yields cofinal global Weil positivity
decision_tree_change_if_refuted: retires this fixed-reference harmonic-renormalization/Carleson proof class; does not refute Weil positivity or other source-dependent lifts
stop_rule: stop if the pure-reference cancellation fails, if the scaled band statistic grows without stabilization under licensed refinement, if the summed Carleson budget is at least the transformed collar budget, or if deriving the estimate invokes positivity of the enlarged zeta form
